title: Chinese Postal Service Commemorative Stamp 1896-1946
descriptionText: The Chinese Postal Service Commemorative Stamp from 1896-1946 is a valuable and historical piece of collectible. Issued during the early to mid-20th century in China, this stamp features a blue color and original gum, making it a prized item for stamp enthusiasts. With a focus on the postal service, this stamp embodies the rich history and culture of China during that time period. It is a genuine piece of China's past, showcasing its vibrant and unique heritage.
